title: A reference class for database screening. — Report-class
text: rawFiles character vector file paths order displayed. settings list settings processing steps. settings list contains following fields defaults: list(db_path = NULL, rttolm = 1, mztolu = 0.05, mztolu_fine = 0.005, chromatography = "bfg_nts_rp1", pol = "pos", ce_s = 30:40, ces_s = 0:15, instr = "LC-ESI-QTOF TripleTOF 5600 SCIEX", ceunit = c("V", "eV"), comparison = "dot_product", threshold = 400, rt_res = 1.5, EIC_extraction = 0.05, baseline_noise_MS1 = 0.5, sn = 3, rtoffset = 0, IS_rtoffset = 0, ISrttolm = 1, blank_int_factor = 3, rtTolReinteg = 1, mzTolReinteg = 0.005, ndp_m = 0.4, ndp_n = 1, mztolu_ms2 = 0.015, area_threshold = 1, height_threshold = 1, use_int_threshold = "area". db_path: path sqlite spectral-database (SDB). rttolm: retention time tolerance suspect search. mztolu: m/z tolerance spectrum extraction (MS2 precursor mass). mztolu_fine: m/z tolerance precursor mass MS1. chromatography chromatographic method allowed SDB. pol: polarity. ce_s: allowed collision energies SDB. ces_s: allowed collision energy spreads SDB. instr: allowed instruments SDB. ceunit: allowed collision energy unit SDB. comparison: algorithm use spectral comparison, currently default allowed. threshold: score spectral comparison results rejected automatically, 1000=perfect match. rt_res: Resolution chrom. peaks (see ms2_search) min. Peaks RT difference > rt_res considered different substances. EIC_extraction: Extraction width produce EIC, affects integration. baseline_noise_MS1: Signals intensity ignored also included saved spectra. sn: signal--noise ratio limit peak integration. rtoffset: Retention time offset samples database. ISrttolm: RT tolerance peak finding integration. blank_int_factor: Intensity factor remove compounds found blank. Peak sample must within blank_int_factor: * intensity blank. rtTolReinteg: retention time tolerance reintegration. mzTolReinteg: m/z tolerance reintegration. ndp_m: Peak intensity weighting factor dot-product, ndp_n: m/z weighting factor dot-product, mztolu_ms2: m/z tolerance dot-product fragment mass binning, area_threshold: Peak area intensity threshold. height_threshold: Peak height intensity threshold. use_int_threshold: can either "area", "height", "none" peaksPerPeak: mustFindChromPeak: default FALSE, TRUE, peaks without area deleted rawFilesCompl data.frame processed files date processing. peakList data.frame suspect search results. currentPeakID numeric keep track peakIDs, change. MS1 data.frame holding MS1 spectra. EIC data.frame holding chromatograms. MS2 data.frame holding MS2 spectra. data.frame list process, imported csv file (comma sep) using method addIS(). csv file columns name, formula, rt, adduct. formula form e.g. CBZ: C14 13CH12N 15NO, adduct form [M+H]+ [M]+. ISresults data.frame results processings. falsePos data.frame recording false positives deleted files

title: Run GenForm with various Commands — RunGenForm
text: ms_file File name plain text, two column file (e.g. MS.txt) containing space-separated mz intensity values MS1 spectrum (full scan). intense peak taken "m" unless defined "mz". msms_file plain text, two column file (e.g. MSMS.txt) containing space-separated mz intensity values tandem (MS2) spectrum, .e. fragments. GenForm can run without MSMS, function requires use stage. ion Ion setting use. Options: c("-e","+e","-H","+H","+Na"). GenFormDir Directory containing GenForm.exe. ResultsDir Directory save GenForm results. Existing files overwritten. ppm Accuracy setting MS1 (default 5 ppm). acc Accuracy setting MS2 (default 15 ppm). elements Selection elements consider. Default "CHNOPS", implemented "CHBrClFINOPSSi". ff "fuzzy formula" input offer control beyond elements. format C0-6H0-20O1-3. dbe Default TRUE writes double bond equivalents output; FALSE suppresses output. oei Default TRUE allows odd electron ions explaining MS/MS peaks, FALSE means even electron ions considered. mz mz >0, mass GenForm use calculate formulas, considering ion setting. Default intense peak ms_file. exist Default TRUE activates existance filter (allowing formulae least one structural formula exists). FALSE recommended use cases. an_loss Activate annotation MSMS fragments subformulas losses. an_loss_limit Define cut-limit annotating subformulas losses. many peaks formulas, becomes time consuming produces massive files limited use. sort Default FALSE produce default output. TRUE, generates additional sorted file sorted combined match value. cleanMSMS Default FALSE. TRUE, produces additional cleaned MSMS file containing peaks subformula annotation.
